518kHz 海上安全与气象信息。: 518 kHz maritime safety and weather information.
BBC、VOA、NHK 等，频率随季节与时段变化。: BBC, VOA, NHK and others; frequencies vary with season and time of day.
SSB / CW / 数字模式，是新手练耳的好材料。: SSB / CW / digital modes — good material for a beginner training the ear.
从一台带 SSB 的短波收音机或 RTL-SDR 开始。: Start with a shortwave receiver that has SSB, or an RTL-SDR.
各地气象台站的气象图传真广播。: Facsimile broadcasts of weather charts from weather services everywhere.
天线对接收至关重要：长线天线加巴伦可显著改善信噪比。: The antenna is crucial for reception: a long-wire antenna with a balun markedly improves SNR.
接收不违法，但切勿擅自发射（无证发射违法）。: Listening is legal, but never transmit on your own initiative (transmitting without a licence is illegal).
机场天气广播，HF / VHF 航空波段。: Airport weather broadcasts on HF / VHF aviation bands.
短波传播随昼夜与季节变化，傍晚/夜间选低段、白天选高段。: Shortwave propagation changes with time of day and season: lower bands in the evening and at night, higher bands by day.
记录接收日志：频率、时间、内容与信号强度（SINPO）。: Keep a reception log: frequency, time, content and signal strength (SINPO).
配合软件解码 RTTY、SSTV、PSK 等信号。: Use software to decode RTTY, SSTV, PSK and similar signals.
